name: Marriott Mena House
description: A historic palace hotel at the foot of the Great Pyramid — many rooms and the pool look straight onto it.

name: Steigenberger El Tahrir
description: Modern, comfortable and great value, a short walk from the Egyptian Museum and the Nile.

name: Sofitel Winter Palace
description: The Victorian grande dame of Luxor on the Corniche, steps from Luxor Temple, with vast tropical gardens.

name: Sofitel Legend Old Cataract
description: Where Agatha Christie wrote Death on the Nile — terraces over the granite islands and feluccas of Aswan.

name: Rixos Alamein
description: An all-inclusive beach resort on the Mediterranean with pools, a kids' club and entertainment.

name: The Address Beach Resort Marassi
description: Polished luxury on Marassi's white-sand bay, close to the marina's restaurants and cafés.

name: Rixos Sharm El Sheikh
description: A big all-inclusive resort with a house reef, many restaurants and plenty for families.

name: Savoy Sharm El Sheikh
description: An elegant beach resort beside SOHO Square, with its own coral reef and a long sandy beach.

name: Swiss Inn Resort Dahab
description: A calm beach resort on Dahab's bay with a pool and dive centre, a few minutes from the town centre.

name: Laguna Vista Dahab
description: Budget-friendly beach hotel on the Lagoon — ideal for windsurfers, kitesurfers and divers.

name: Morgenland Village
description: Stone chalets in the mountains, a practical base for the night climb of Mount Sinai.

name: Daniela Village
description: Simple, friendly and good value, close to the monastery and the Mount Sinai trail.
